title: Sessions: generation, expiry, rotation and invalidation

videos.script: A patient signs in once. After that, every request she sends carries one thing: a cookie with a session id. {{cookie}} To the portal, that id is the patient. Whoever holds it is lucia, with no password asked. {{holder}} So the id has to be impossible to guess. It has to change the moment she signs in. {{rotate}} It has to stop working when she walks away from the screen, and after a working day at most. {{expire}} And when she presses sign out, it has to die on the server, not only in her browser. {{die}} Four moments: born, rotated, expired, ended. Today six tests check each of them in your own portal. They fail, and then they pass. {{today}}
